messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Eliara (Sr ML Eng candidate) is coming for a hybrid interview the week of June 2. We need to lock a panel slot, quiet room for onsite portion, loaner laptop (USB-C + HDMI), parking pass or travel stipend, and note dietary restrictions. Can people confirm availability?

Tom (Hiring Manager): I can move things around. Prefer Wed morning but can do afternoon if needed.

Liam (Interviewer): Wed morning won't work for me, booked with client. I have Wed 2–4pm PT or Thu 9–11am PT.

Zoe (Scheduler): From Eliara's email: available Tue 10–12 PT, Wed 2–4 PT, Fri 9–11 PT. She requested a quiet room when onsite, two monitors if possible, and a USB-C hub. Also mentioned she'll fly in and asked about parking vs. Uber stipend.

Aisha (People Ops): Ok — Wed 2pm PT seems the only overlap so far. Tom, can you shift to Wed 2pm? That keeps the interview contiguous.

Tom (Hiring Manager): I can shift to Wed 2pm — fine. I prefer we keep the loop to 3 interviewers + 30m debrief.

Liam (Interviewer): Wed 2pm works.

Nina (Office Admin): I can reserve a quiet room (Conf C — it's inner office, low foot traffic) and provision a loaner MacBook Pro with USB-C dongle + HDMI adapter. For travel: we can either issue a parking pass or provide a prepaid ride credit. Parking pass requires front-desk pickup on arrival; Uber credit needs approvals but I can issue under candidate-expenses card. Which do we want?

Aisha (People Ops): Candidate asked for either. To keep it simple, let's offer an Uber credit. Who approves the spend?

Tom (Hiring Manager): Approve from my side. Charge to hiring budget.

Nina (Office Admin): Got it — I'll process the prepaid ride. I'll also arrange door escort and a badge for the day.

Zoe (Scheduler): Draft calendar (will send after final confirm):

```
Wed Jun 4 — Candidate: Eliara (Sr ML Eng) — Hybrid
14:00–14:15 — Welcome + setup (Conf C / Zoom)
14:15–15:00 — Interview 1 (Tom)
15:00–15:45 — Interview 2 (Liam)
15:45–16:15 — Debrief (panel)
Notes: 30m buffer after for travel/setup. Onsite: 2 screens + USB-C hub, vegetarian, nut-free lunch at 11:30 if onsite earlier.
```

Aisha (People Ops): Also: Eliara has a nut allergy — request vegetarian, nut-free lunch. @Nina can you confirm catering?

Nina (Office Admin): Noted. I'll place a vegetarian, nut-free boxed lunch and mark dietary allergy on badge. Catering ETA 11:30.

Tom (Hiring Manager): Please send travel stipend instructions to candidate and include parking/arrival instructions + badge pickup. Also add onboarding link and meeting prep doc.

Zoe (Scheduler): Will do. I'll send the invite to panel + candidate once the Uber credit is confirmed and Nina confirms room + loaner. Expect invites in ~30m. :thumbsup:

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks team — tagging this as final unless anything else pops up. I'll post the arrival checklist in the candidate folder and ping security for escort.

Nina (Office Admin): Done — room reserved, loaner queued, catering ordered, Uber credit initiated. I'll DM Eliara the pickup code and door instructions.

Zoe (Scheduler): Invites sent. Calendar shows Conf C reserved and Zoom link included. Closing thread.
